open-x-embodiment.description: Open X-Embodiment is an open, large-scale manipulation dataset initiated by Google DeepMind with 34 global labs. It unifies 60 robotics datasets into RLDS format across 22 robot embodiments and 1M+ trajectories, serving as the foundational cross-embodiment pretraining corpus.
highlights: First large-scale cross-embodiment open manipulation dataset with 1M+ trajectories
Integrates 60 datasets from 34 labs across 21 institutions
Permissive Apache-2.0 license, friendly to commercial use
Core pretraining foundation for RT-X, OpenVLA, Octo and more

specs.annotations: Natural language instructions and task labels

agibot-world.description: AgiBot World is a million-scale real-world embodied dataset open-sourced by AgiBot. Collected via VR teleoperation in dedicated data factories with quality assurance, it spans 1M+ trajectories and ~2,976.4 hours across 217 real-world tasks.
highlights: 1M+ real-world bimanual trajectories totaling approx. 2,976.4 hours
Covers 5 major domains: home, catering, industrial, retail and office
Standardized QA pipeline ensuring high-quality long-horizon bimanual data
Open-sourced alongside the GO-1 embodied foundation model

specs.embodiments: AgiBot Genie G1 and wheeled bimanual platforms
specs.annotations: Fine-grained subtasks and natural language action labels
specs.collection_method: Dedicated factory VR teleoperation with QA verification

robomind-2.description: RoboMIND 2.0 is a multimodal bimanual mobile manipulation dataset comprising 310K real trajectories (1,000+ hours) across 6 heterogeneous embodiments, plus 12K tactile-enriched episodes, 20K mobile manipulation trajectories, and digital-twin USD assets.
highlights: 310K dual-arm trajectories (1,000+ hours) across 6 heterogeneous robot embodiments
Includes 12K tactile-enriched sequences and 20K mobile manipulation episodes
Releases high-fidelity digital-twin USD assets and 20K aligned sim trajectories
Validated with π0, π0.5, HybridVLA and other mainstream VLAs

specs.modalities: Multi-view RGB + 12K tactile sequences + 20K mobile manipulation
specs.annotations: Fine-grained natural language descriptions and aligned states
specs.collection_method: Unified teleoperation pipeline + digital-twin USD sim (20K sim)

droid.description: DROID (Distributed Robot Interaction Dataset) was collected across 13 institutions in North America, Europe and Asia using standardized Franka Panda 7-DoF arms, totaling 76,000 teleoperated trajectories (~350 hours) across 564 real scenes.
highlights: High in-the-wild scene diversity across 564 real rooms and tabletops
Fully standardized hardware (Franka Panda + calibrated stereo cameras)
MIT license; widely used as a benchmark by OpenVLA, π0 and MolmoAct2
Full open-source hardware setup and calibration scripts provided

specs.modalities: Dual external stereo cameras + wrist RGB-D + proprioception
specs.collection_method: 50 collectors across 13 labs over 12 months via teleoperation

bridgedata-v2.description: BridgeData V2 is a classic open-source manipulation dataset from UC Berkeley and partners containing 60,096 WidowX 250 trajectories across 24 environments, supporting both language and goal-image conditioning under CC BY 4.0.
highlights: One of the most widely used open datasets on low-cost WidowX arms
60,096 trajectories supporting language and goal-image conditioning
Rich kitchen/sink/tabletop scenes; standard benchmark for early VLAs
Permissive CC BY 4.0 license for commercial and academic use

specs.annotations: Natural language instructions and goal images

rh20t.description: RH20T is a multimodal manipulation dataset led by Shanghai Jiao Tong University with 110,000+ sequences (~40 TB), capturing multi-view RGB-D alongside 6-axis force/torque, tactile and audio signals paired with human demonstrations.
highlights: 110,000+ sequences totaling ~40 TB (5 TB RGB / 10 TB RGB-D extracted)
Rare multimodal coverage: vision, 6-axis F/T, tactile and audio
Every robot trajectory is paired with a corresponding human demonstration
Clear split between commercial (RH20T-C) and non-commercial (RH20T-NC) subsets

specs.embodiments: Multiple arms (Franka, UR5, KUKA, Flexiv, etc.)
specs.modalities: Multi-view RGB-D + wrist 6-axis F/T + audio + tactile
specs.annotations: Paired human demo videos + language and skill labels
specs.collection_method: Human teleoperation + paired human demonstration videos

molmoact2-bimanual-yam.description: MolmoAct2-BimanualYAM is a 720-hour teleoperated bimanual dataset released by Ai2 in May 2026 alongside MolmoAct2, providing unified language re-annotations and forming the largest fully open bimanual dataset to date.
highlights: Largest fully open bimanual teleoperation dataset to date at 720 hours
Released together with MolmoAct2 weights, OpenFAST Tokenizer and curated DROID/SO-100 subsets
Optimized for accessible bimanual platforms to reproduce strong VLA baselines
Includes unified language re-annotation pipeline and training recipes

specs.modalities: Multi-view RGB + bimanual proprioception + continuous actions
specs.annotations: Fine-grained instructions via unified language re-annotation

lerobot-community.description: LeRobot Community Datasets aggregate open manipulation trajectories on Hugging Face Hub from low-cost arms like SO-100/101 and ALOHA in the compact LeRobotDataset v3.0 (Parquet + MP4) format.
highlights: Deeply integrated with Hugging Face Hub for one-line dataset loading
LeRobotDataset v3.0 uses compact, fast Parquet + MP4 storage
Entirely powers SmolVLA training (~23K public community trajectories)
Most active open data hub for low-cost SO-100/101 robot arms

specs.tasks_count: Hundreds of community tabletop & mobile tasks
specs.embodiments: SO-100/101, ALOHA, Koch, LeKiwi low-cost open arms

fastumi-100k.description: FastUMI-100K is a large-scale open-source handheld UMI dataset containing 100,000 trajectories (~600 hours) collected with the hardware-independent FastUMI gripper, pairing 60 fps wrist fisheye video with real-time RealSense T265 6-DoF TCP trajectories.
highlights: One of the largest open robot-free UMI datasets: 100K trajectories and ~600 hours
Real-time T265 6-DoF tracking avoids offline SLAM reconstruction failures
Consistent fingertip-aligned fisheye view enables cross-arm transfer
Open-sourced alongside FastUMI hardware designs and conversion tools

specs.tasks_count: Diverse everyday and tabletop manipulation tasks
specs.embodiments: Hardware-decoupled (FastUMI handheld gripper, transferable to diverse arms)
specs.modalities: Wrist fisheye RGB (720p@60fps) + RealSense T265 6-DoF TCP pose + gripper width
specs.annotations: Natural language instructions and subtask labels
specs.collection_method: Robot-free human demonstration with FastUMI handheld gripper

nvidia-open-h-embodiment.description: PhysicalAI-Robotics-Open-H-Embodiment is NVIDIA's open multi-embodiment healthcare robotics dataset collection on Hugging Face, uniting paired kinematics and video in LeRobot format for surgical robotics and autonomous ultrasound.
highlights: First open multi-embodiment dataset collection tailored for surgical and ultrasound Physical AI
Standardized in LeRobot format with paired video and kinematics
Bridges the gap in sub-millimeter medical precision manipulation
Integrated with NVIDIA Isaac for Healthcare simulation and training pipelines

specs.tasks_count: Surgical manipulation and ultrasound scanning tasks
specs.embodiments: Multiple surgical and medical robotic arm embodiments
specs.modalities: Paired endoscopic/ultrasound video + fine kinematic trajectories
specs.annotations: Surgical phase and action instruction annotations

robotwin-2.description: RoboTwin 2.0 Dataset is a scalable open-source bimanual manipulation benchmark comprising 100,000+ pre-collected trajectories (~79.6 GB) across 50 tasks and 731 objects, natively packaged in LeRobot v3.0 format under Apache-2.0.
highlights: 100,000+ trajectories (~79.6 GB) covering 50 bimanual tasks and 731 objects
Natively formatted in LeRobot v3.0 under a permissive Apache-2.0 license
Combines LLM-guided expert synthesis with domain randomization in cluttered scenes
Accepted at ICML 2026; widely used for bimanual VLA evaluation and fine-tuning
applications: Direct training in the LeRobot ecosystem

specs.collection_method: Automated expert synthesis pipeline + domain-randomized simulation

robocoin.description: RoboCOIN is an open-source multi-embodiment bimanual manipulation dataset released in Nov 2025, featuring 180,000+ real-world demonstrations across 15 robotic platforms to advance cross-embodiment bimanual generalization.
highlights: 180,000+ real-world demonstrations spanning 15 distinct bimanual robot platforms
Focuses on cross-embodiment action representation across heterogeneous dual-arm setups
Open-sourced in Nov 2025 as a large real-world corpus for bimanual VLAs
Covers collaborative grasping, tidying and assembly in domestic and industrial settings

specs.modalities: Multi-view RGB vision + bimanual proprioception & actions
specs.annotations: Fine-grained action instructions & unified cross-embodiment labels
specs.collection_method: Coordinated real-robot capture across 15 bimanual platforms

egodex.description: EgoDex is Apple's large-scale egocentric dexterous manipulation dataset containing 829 hours of 1080p@30Hz Apple Vision Pro video (~338,000 episodes) across 194 tabletop tasks, paired with 68-joint 3D hand and upper-body tracking under CC BY-NC-ND.
highlights: Apple's massive egocentric dexterous dataset: 829 hours, 338K episodes, 194 tabletop tasks
1080p@30Hz Apple Vision Pro video paired with 68-joint 3D hand, head & upper-body poses
Purpose-built for learning dexterous 5-finger manipulation from human video
Key human-video pretraining source for humanoids and dexterous hands in 2025–2026

specs.embodiments: Human egocentric + 68-joint 3D hand/upper-body poses (for humanoid/hand transfer)
specs.modalities: 1080p@30Hz egocentric RGB (~90M frames) + 3D hand/head/body tracking + intrinsics
specs.annotations: Natural language task descriptions & per-frame 68-joint 3D poses
specs.collection_method: Apple Vision Pro ARKit on-device SLAM capture

ego-exo4d.description: Ego-Exo4D, released by Meta AI and 12 research labs, provides 1,286 hours (5,035 takes) of time-synchronized egocentric (Project Aria) and 4-view exocentric video across 43 skilled tasks and 123 scenes, paired with 6-DoF pose and 3D hand annotations.
highlights: 1,286 hours (5,035 takes) of synchronized Aria egocentric + 4 exocentric camera views
Covers 43 skilled tasks and 689 keysteps across 123 scenes in 13 global cities
Includes 6-DoF pose, 3D hand tracking and cross-view alignment benchmarks
Foundational dataset for cross-view human-to-robot skill transfer

specs.embodiments: Human multi-view skill demonstrations (Project Aria + 4 exocentric views)
specs.modalities: 1 egocentric + 4 synchronized exocentric views + 6-DoF, hand pose & 3D point clouds
specs.annotations: 689 fine-grained keysteps, expert commentary & proficiency labels
specs.collection_method: Synchronized capture across 12 labs & 740 wearers in 13 cities

behavior-1k.description: BEHAVIOR-1K from Stanford University is a large-scale embodied simulation benchmark and dataset built on OmniGibson, defining 1,000 long-horizon household activities across 50 interactive scenes alongside 20,000 human VR teleoperation trajectories covering 100 tasks.
highlights: 1,000 human-grounded, long-horizon household activities in OmniGibson
50 interactive 3D scenes with 9,000+ rigid, deformable and articulated objects
Includes 20,000 human VR teleoperation trajectories across 100 tasks for imitation learning
Supports complex physics including fluids, cloth and thermodynamics

specs.tasks_count: 1,000 household activities (incl. 20K teleop trajectories over 100 tasks)
specs.embodiments: Mobile manipulators (Fetch / R1 and sim embodiments)
specs.modalities: High-fidelity sim RGB-D + physical state + teleoperation trajectories
specs.annotations: BDDL goal states & human teleoperation demos
specs.collection_method: OmniGibson physics simulation + human VR teleoperation

libero.description: LIBERO is a foundational benchmark and dataset for lifelong robot learning and language-conditioned manipulation, comprising 130 tasks across four suites (LIBERO-Spatial, Object, Goal, and 100) and serving as a standard evaluation benchmark for modern VLAs.
highlights: Standard benchmark for evaluating VLAs across 4 suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, 100) and 130 tasks
Tests spatial relations, object generalization, goal shifts, and lifelong knowledge transfer
Used by virtually all leading VLAs including OpenVLA-OFT, π0, MolmoAct2, and Galaxea G0.5
Community-converted to LeRobot v3 format with extensions like LIBERO-Industry

specs.modalities: Dual-view RGB (third-person + wrist) + joint states & actions
specs.annotations: Natural language instructions & procedural task generation pipeline
specs.collection_method: Human teleoperation demos + procedural task generation

ego4d.description: Ego4D from Meta AI and 13 universities is the largest egocentric daily-life video dataset, spanning 3,670 hours (~7.1 TB) from 931 participants across 74 locations in 9 countries with hand-object contact, narration, gaze, and 3D mesh annotations.
highlights: Largest open egocentric daily-life video dataset at 3,670 hours (~7.1 TB)
Captured across 74 locations in 9 countries covering rich everyday hand-object interactions
Five benchmark tracks: episodic memory, hand-object interaction, AV diarization, social, forecasting
Core human-video pretraining foundation alongside Ego-Exo4D and EgoDex
applications: World model & physical commonsense video pretraining

specs.modalities: Egocentric RGB video + audio + 3D environment meshes + gaze + stereo
specs.annotations: Dense narrations, hand-object contact, object boxes & episodic memory
specs.collection_method: Unscripted daily-life capture by 931 participants across consortium labs
